reply.text: {"say":"A full push day with nothing but your bodyweight: chest leads with push-ups at three angles, then shoulders with pike push-ups, and triceps finish with diamond push-ups and bench dips.","title":"Bodyweight Push","days":[{"name":"Push","exercises":[{"key":"push-up","sets":4,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Full range, chest to an inch off the floor"},{"key":"decline-push-up","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Feet on a step or couch, body rigid"},{"key":"pike-push-up","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Hips high, head travels forward of hands"},{"key":"wide-push-up","sets":3,"reps":10,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Slow lowering, stretch the chest"},{"key":"diamond-push-up","sets":3,"reps":8,"repsTo":12,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Elbows stay tight to your sides"},{"key":"bench-dip","sets":3,"reps":12,"repsTo":15,"seconds":0,"group":"","part":"main","note":"Use a chair edge, shoulders down"}]}],"unmet":[]}
